paths.name: @videosdk.live/react-sdk
paths.message: The VideoSDK SDK may only be imported from src/sdk/, the app-owned seam. Import from src/sdk instead so an SDK bump touches one directory.

patterns.message: The seam covers deep paths too. `@videosdk.live/react-sdk/dist/types/...` is still the SDK, and importing its types outside src/sdk/ couples feature code to the vendor's type names just as tightly as importing its hooks.
